name: threadback-mcp-server
description: Threadback Deterministic Personal-Context MCP Server for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime & Alexa+

tools.name: discover_unfinished_threads
tools.description: Discover open intention threads requiring attention, filtered by minimum staleness days and optional limit.

tools.name: get_thread_context
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive contextual details and historical events for a specific intention thread.

tools.name: find_thread_blockers
tools.description: Identify external dependencies, missing prerequisites, or waiting conditions that block progress.

tools.name: analyze_thread
tools.description: Perform deterministic intent and evidence analysis on a thread, computing confidence, staleness, and blocker severity.

tools.name: suggest_next_action
tools.description: Determine the single recommended next action to advance an intention thread, with deterministic confidence and rationale.

tools.name: prepare_action
tools.description: Prepare a structured, safe ActionProposal with explicit confirmation boundaries and human-reviewable payload. Pre-execution only.

tools.name: execute_action
tools.description: Execute an approved ActionProposal in a safe, controlled simulated environment. Requires proposal ID and explicit confirmation.
